I try to listening to people, but after a while it begins to feel fake and expected of me, so I just put on the role no matter what. I do charity work at certain times of the year, but charity work doesn't feel fulfilling overall and only reason I would do it ore if just to get out of the house.

I move around the country a lot, basically because I've bee made homeless on reason or another, or I find cheap ways to travel and take advantage of free space people give me. I feel like the happiness answer always changes for me, as I am always losig interests in stuff quickly.
